title: Road Obstruction Report: Ravine Crossing at Mile 14
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Field notes from the southern road inspection. At Mile 14, the paved road breaks off into a deep canyon with steep drop-offs. Leona Bracken stopped to inspect the gap.

Although visibly nervous about the height, Leona volunteered to jump the span to help her party across. She told her companions: "I am terribly afraid of falling, but there is no other way. Hop on my back, one at a time, and I will try to jump it."
She successfully made three round-trip leaps across the gorge carrying passengers and baggage, allowing the entire party to continue without detour.
